mike-acme: Hey team — our trial account (acct_0xACME) shows no debit after completing a streaming session. We finalized the stream and received 200, but balance still says 0/500 used. Can you help investigate?

liz: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the request/response and any server-side IDs (session_id / finalize_event_id)?

mike-acme: Session id: sess_2026_03_11_42, finalize_event_id: evt_fin_1845678901. Request payload we send on finalize (from our SDK):
```json
{"session_id":"sess_2026_03_11_42","idempotency_key":"idemp-abc-123","finalize":true}
```
Note: we do not see consumed_tokens in the SDK payload for some sessions. Response: 200 OK, body: {"status":"finalized","session":"sess_2026_03_11_42"}

liz: Hmm, that payload is missing token counts. Omitting consumed_tokens should be fine if server computes consumption from events, but looks like our ledger has no debit. @omar can you pull the ledger lines for acct_0xACME around that time?

omar: Pulling... ledger query result for acct_0xACME around ts 1845678900-1845678950:
```
1845678899 - credit +500 (trial grant)
1845678902 - finalize evt evt_fin_1845678901 -> delta 0.0
1845678920 - ingest tokens +120 (internal tracking)
```

omar: So server accepted the finalize but recorded 0 delta. There are ingest logs showing 120 tokens processed, but billing delta is 0.

ingrid: I can repro locally with the open-source SDK if the finalize payload is truncated by the client retry logic (idempotent retry that resends only the finalize flag and drops the usage block). Repro steps: 1) Open streaming session 2) send chunks -> server emits partial usage events 3) on network hiccup, SDK retry finalizes with a minimal payload (no consumed_tokens) and the server's finalize handler currently expects either consumed_tokens or a precomputed usage snapshot. If usage snapshot missing, it falls through and writes delta 0.

liz: That matches. Is there a server-side fallback to compute consumption from stored partial events?

omar: There is supposed to be. Looks like a race: the ingestion pipeline writes token-emit events asynchronously; the finalize handler reads a cached snapshot. If ingestion hasn't flushed to the snapshot store at finalize time, our handler records 0 and doesn't queue a reconciliation job.

ingrid: Proposed fix: 1) Make finalize handler attempt to compute consumption from raw event stream when snapshot is absent (blocking read for up to 2s) 2) If still missing, enqueue a reconciliation job to run asap that re-computes and patches the ledger 3) SDK patch to always include a best-effort consumed_tokens field on finalize retry.

billing-bot: Reconciliation job scheduled: recon_job_1845678940 for acct_0xACME, target events sess_2026_03_11_42.

omar: I applied a hotfix to enqueue reconciliation for now — it found the events and patched the ledger. Ledger patch log:
```
1845678948 - recon_job recon_job_1845678940 applied -> delta -120 tokens billed
1845678948 - new balance 380/500
```

mike-acme: Confirmed on our side — UI now shows 120 tokens consumed, balance updated to 380. Thanks.

liz: We'll push the SDK patch (include best-effort consumption in finalize) and the server fallback in the next deploy. Omar — can you follow up on adding an alert when finalize handler writes delta == 0 but there are recent ingest events?

omar: Yep, adding alert rule now (internally: billing.finalize.mismatch).

ingrid: I'll open a short postmortem and link the PRs. Root cause: SDK retry + eventual ingestion flush race producing finalize payload with no consumption and no server fallback -> zero-billing write.

liz: Thanks everyone. @mike-acme I'll leave this thread open until you confirm no other sessions are affected. :thumbsup:

mike-acme: All good so far, will ping if we see recurrence. Appreciate the quick turn.
